title: Release visuals pack: onboarding quickstart tiles + overlayed before/after shots
creator: Marcus Green
description: Create a modular image pack for the upcoming release notes and blog that showcases onboarding / quickstart improvements. Deliverables: hero banner (wide), three feature callout tiles (desktop + mobile variants), a before/after carousel set demonstrating flow improvements, and annotated overlay assets (hotspots + short copy). Exports must include web-optimized PNG/JPEG, 2x retina PNGs, and source slices in the shared Figma file. Include copy snippets for each asset and alt text for accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: Hero banner sized for blog header (1600x600) with approved headline and subhead
Three 960x540 feature tiles showing UI callouts with consistent annotation style
Before/After carousel: exact matching crops so transitions align across frames
Mobile screenshots exported at 375x812 with safe-area safe cropping
All assets uploaded to Drive folder and referenced in release PR with image links
Alt text written and QAed with accessibility steward
Design handoff completed: slices + export tokens + filename convention documented
tasks: Audit current quickstart screenshots and collect latest builds from staging
Design new overlay templates (annotation style, pointer, microcopy)
Compose before/after scenes using same app path and seed data
Apply brand color tweaks for contrast and export variants
Write alt text and short captions for marketing team
Create export manifest and upload to Drive
Add asset links to release PR and notify marketing and docs
